title: Understanding k-Means Clustering
text: k-Means clustering is a method used to partition a dataset into k distinct, non-overlapping subsets (clusters). Each cluster is represented by its center, which is the mean of the points in the cluster.

title: Impact of Initialization
text: The initial placement of cluster centers can significantly affect the final clustering result. Poor initialization can lead to suboptimal clustering.

title: Convergence of k-Means
text: k-Means clustering iteratively refines the positions of the cluster centers until convergence, which is when the centers no longer change significantly.

title: Evaluating Statements
text: Consider the statement: 'The initial placement of cluster centers does not affect the final result of k-Means clustering.' Is this statement true or false?
